method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Asian stocks trade mixed after Nvidia earnings, KOSPI leads gains
Equities.summary: Asian equities trade mixed on Wednesday. Nvidia shrugged off recent turmoil to post a better-than-expected sales forecast. However, investor confidence remains fragile over questions about the company's future leadership and potential impacts ‌on its regional
Equities.reason: Regional market reaction: Nvidia's strong sales outlook provides a modest positive impulse to Asian equities but leadership uncertainty keeps sentiment fragile — overall mildly positive for broader equities risk.

Equities.title: Wall Street expects corporate earnings growth to halve next year
Equities.summary: Analysts forecast profit growth will dip to 16% globally from 33.5% as pace of AI capex expansion slows
Equities.reason: Major macro earnings narrative: a large slowdown in expected profit growth is a meaningful negative for equity valuations and the AI-driven growth story, raising downside risk for broad markets.

Equities.title: Nvidia insists Huang will not return as CEO as it reports strong sales
Equities.summary: Chip giant raises next year’s financial forecasts as it doubled revenue last quarter
Equities.reason: High-impact company result: Nvidia's beat and upgraded guidance materially supports market risk appetite and the AI leadership thesis, while the board's decision on Huang resolves a key governance overhang — net strongly positive for tech/market leadership names.

Equities.title: Asia stocks cling to gains after Nvidia earnings as Anthropic pricing looms
Equities.reason: Market-wrap signalling: Nvidia's results underpin regional gains, but near-term volatility risk remains from the Anthropic IPO — modestly positive net for equity sentiment in Asia.

Equities.title: Wall Street's fear gauge is surging again and this time it's not just about AI jitters
Equities.summary: VIX up four days in a row as options traders show fear unseen since April
Equities.reason: Risk-off signal: rising VIX shows increasing volatility and risk aversion that can cap equity upside even with idiosyncratic positives like Nvidia's results.

Equities.title: 'Business as usual': Nvidia's Kress passes first test as board slams door on Huang
Equities.reason: Governance resolution: Reuters report that the interim leadership has passed an early credibility test supports stability in the stock and reduces a tail-risk for the AI leadership group — positive for tech sector sentiment.

Equities.title: Trading Day: AI trade unwind continues, but Nvidia beats
Equities.reason: Broader regime signal: Reuters commentary that the AI trade unwind persists indicates continuing pressure on the concentrated AI/mega-cap trade despite single-stock beats — net modestly negative for the dominant equity impulse.

Equities.title: Anthropic likely to price IPO above the current range of $70 to $78, sources tell CNBC
Equities.summary: Anthropic is slated to list on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol "ANT" and start trading on Nov. 19.
Equities.reason: AI-sector flow event: a stronger-than-expected Anthropic IPO price would validate investor appetite for AI listings and could re-ignite risk flows into related equities, providing a modest positive to sentiment.

Rates.title: BoJ’s Ueda: Crucial to ensure inflation stays near 2%
Rates.summary: Bank of Japan (BoJ) Governor Kazuo Ueda said on Wednesday that it’s important to ensure inflation stays near the 2% target. Ueda added that the central bank will keep raising the policy rate based on economic, price and financial trends.
Rates.reason: BoJ governor signaling continued rate increases is a clear hawkish signal for JGB yields and influences global rates via term premium; negative for bond prices (yields up). High relevance given central-bank guidance on policy path.

Rates.title: Breaking: United Kingdom CPI inflation climbs to 3.6% YoY in October, but misses 3.7% estimates
Rates.summary: The United Kingdom (UK) headline Consumer Price Index (CPI) climbed 3.6% over the year in October, compared to a rise of 3.5% in September, the data released by the Office for National Statistics (ONS) showed on Wednesday.
Rates.reason: Headline CPI came in below market estimates despite ticking up vs prior; relative miss likely eases near-term BoE tightening bets and is modestly bond-positive (yields could fall). UK CPI is a high-impact input to rates pricing.

Rates.title: Indonesia central bank hikes rates to support rupiah
Rates.reason: Bank Indonesia raising rates is a direct tightening of monetary policy that lifts local yields and reflects global EM rate divergence; negative for Indonesian bond prices and relevant for EM rates/flows.

Rates.title: Japan 20-Year Bond Sale Draws Weak Demand Amid Global Volatility
Rates.reason: Weak demand at a 20-year JGB auction signals reduced buyer appetite and/or higher term premiums, implying upward pressure on yields; directly relevant to rates and gilt market dynamics.

Rates.title: Treasuries’ Big Short Sets Up ‘Pain Trade’ as Haven Bid Ramps Up
Rates.reason: Significant short positioning in Treasuries creates vulnerability to a rally if risk-off flows accelerate (haven bid), implying a potential sharp downward move in yields (bond-positive). Market positioning risk makes this relevant.

Rates.title: Fidelity Says Even at 6% Treasuries Fail to Be ‘Massively Cheap’
Rates.reason: Institutional view that Treasuries are not 'massively cheap' at current yields could cap demand and keep upward pressure on yields; relevant as a sentiment/valuation signal but lower impact than policy or auction news.

FX.title: Australian Dollar declines below 0.6750 on hawkish Fed, traders await FOMC Minutes
FX.summary: The AUD/USD pair loses momentum to around 0.6725 during the Asian trading hours on Wednesday. Hawkish comments from Federal Reserve (Fed) officials provide some support to the US Dollar (USD) against the Australian Dollar (AUD).
FX.reason: Clear USD-strength narrative (hawkish Fed) weighing on AUD/USD. Direct USD-pair move, timely ahead of FOMC minutes — medium relevance for USD-dominant FX flows.

FX.title: Japanese Yen softens after BoJ Ueda’s remarks, FOMC Minutes in focus
FX.summary: The USD/JPY pair gains ground to near 159.55 during the early Asian trading hours on Wednesday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) remains weak against the US Dollar (USD) following comments from Bank ‌of Japan ‌(BoJ) Governor Kazuo Ueda.
FX.reason: Significant JPY weakness vs USD driven by BoJ comments and Fed minutes focus — large FX-pair move with policy-driver; high relevance for USD/JPY and risk sentiment.

FX.title: Euro loses ground below 1.1000 as Fed December hike odds rise, eyes on FOMC Minutes
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair attracts some sellers to near 1.0980 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday.
FX.reason: EUR weakness vs USD on rising Fed hiking odds — direct USD-pair move and part of a broader USD-strength narrative ahead of FOMC minutes.

FX.title: United States Dollar index struggles to extend rally beyond 103.80, FOMC Minutes eyed
FX.summary: The US Dollar (USD) turns flat in the early trade on Wednesday after giving back its mild early gains. As of writing, the US Dollar Index (DXY), which gauges the Greenback’s value against six major currencies, trades almost flat at around 103.60.
FX.reason: DXY remains high but struggling to extend gains — modest USD-positive/neutral signal relevant as a cross-cutting gauge for other FX moves ahead of FOMC minutes.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar weakens as US Dollar gains on hawkish Fed tone
FX.summary: USD/CAD appreciates after posting minor losses the previous day, trading around 1.4310 during Asian hours on Wednesday.
FX.reason: USD strength (hawkish Fed tone) pushing USD/CAD higher — direct commodity-currency/FX transmission with market-relevant price levels (April 2025 highs).

FX.title: Swiss Franc weakens as US Dollar remains stronger ahead of FOMC Meeting Minutes
FX.summary: USD/CHF gains ground after posting minor losses in the previous day, trading near a fresh 18-month high of 0.8419 during Asian hours on Wednesday.
FX.reason: USD strength lifting USD/CHF to multimonth highs — clear USD-centric move with relevance for safe-haven FX and cross-asset positioning ahead of Fed minutes.

FX.title: Indian Rupee rallies further amid continuous foreign inflows in Indian stock market
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) extends its winning streak for the third trading day against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday. The USD/INR pair weakens further to near 93.26 as multiple tailwinds have underpinned the Indian currency, which are consistent foreign inflow
FX.reason: EMFX-strength narrative: sustained foreign inflows supporting INR and weighing on USD/INR — USD weakness vs an EM currency, relevant for EM flow dynamics and global USD demand.

FX.title: China Sets Strongest Yuan Fixing Since 2022 as APEC Begins
FX.reason: PBOC fixing materially allowing CNY gains — central-bank FX action with broad EM/Asia implications that represents a meaningful USD-negative signal and potential flow shift.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar struggles near 0.5500 as dovish RBNZ and firm USD cap upside
FX.summary: The NZD/USD pair edges higher during the Asian session on Wednesday, though it seems to struggle to build on the move beyond the 0.5500 psychological mark.
FX.reason: Dovish RBNZ commentary and a firm USD capping NZD upside — direct USD-pair signal with typical relevance for Antipodean FX reaction to global USD/Fed dynamics.

Commodities.title: WTI rebounds to near $84.50 amid Middle East shipping risks
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), the US crude oil benchmark, is trading around $84.50 during the early Asian trading hours on Wednesday. WTI recovers as strikes in the Middle East remain a threat to shipping in the region.
Commodities.reason: Middle East shipping/strike risk lifts oil risk premium and is a near-term bullish driver for WTI; sizable relevance given regional supply disruption potential.

Commodities.title: Oil Steadies as Renewed Mideast Fighting Tests Supply Recovery
Commodities.reason: Renewed fighting in the Middle East tests the supply recovery narrative — a clear bullish supply-risk signal for crude with material market implications.

Commodities.title: Smaller Tankers Join Hormuz Shuttle Trade to Keep Oil Flowing
Commodities.reason: Logistical workaround (smaller tankers/Hormuz shuttle) mitigates some shipping disruption risk, reducing the near-term oil risk premium — bearish offset to headline tensions.

Commodities.title: EIA forecasts Alaskan crude oil production to grow 13% in 2027
Commodities.summary: After decades of decline, crude oil production in Alaska is growing, driven by two projects on Alaska's North Slope. In our latest Short-Term Energy Outlook, we expect a 23,000 barrels per day (b/d) (6%) increase in 2026, followed by a 60,000 b/d (13%) rise in
Commodities.reason: Medium-term supply addition from Alaska increases expected global crude supply — modestly bearish for oil fundamentals over 2027 horizon.

Commodities.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
Commodities.summary: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructur
Commodities.reason: Gulf Coast hurricane-driven shut-ins pose a direct near-term supply disruption risk for US oil/gas production — supportive for prices while disruptions last.

Commodities.title: Gold Slumps Below $3,800 as Fed Officials Signal More Rate Hikes
Commodities.reason: Fed officials signalling further rate hikes raises real yields and strengthens the dollar, a dominant bearish driver for gold; high relevance given macro policy impact on precious metals.

Commodities.title: Gold stays week below $3,800 as traders look to FOMC Minutes for Fed rate cues
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) sticks to intraday losses below the $3,800 mark through the early European session, trading near its lowest level since September 2025, which it touched this Wednesday.
Commodities.reason: Intraday weakness tied to Fed rate expectations and a stronger USD — reinforces the dominant bearish macro narrative for gold.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD drops to 13-month lows amid hawkish Fed outlook
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) depreciates after registering modest gains in the previous day, trading around $45.80 per troy ounce during Asian hours on Wednesday.
Commodities.reason: Silver down alongside gold as hawkish Fed expectations lift real rates and the USD — bearish for precious metals, though slightly lower relevance vs gold.

Commodities.title: Druckenmiller says he is short copper, warns of economic weakness in 2027
Commodities.reason: Macro investor positioning and forecast of weaker 2027 demand for copper imply downside risk via demand expectations; relevant but lower relevance as it's an opinion rather than a data-driven supply/demand shift.

Crypto.title: Crypto's 'casino-chips' are disappearing, adding to pain from spot ETF outflows
Crypto.reason: Broad-market liquidity and product-flow story: shrinking retail/altcoin liquidity plus continued spot-ETF outflows amplifies downward pressure on crypto risk assets. High relevance because it describes market-wide funding and flow dynamics that drive price action.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin remains penned in near $64,000 even as ETF outflow streak ends
Crypto.reason: Market-update: ETF outflows paused but price stuck near resistance—signals lack of fresh demand. Moderately negative since flows pressure persists despite a temporary stop to outflows.

Crypto.title: Live updates: Bitcoin stuck near $65,000 as popular 'basis trade' returns dry up
Crypto.reason: Funding/arbitrage transmission: fall in basis-trade returns reduces demand from arbitrageurs and financing providers, removing a key bid for BTC — important negative flow factor for price.

Crypto.title: Binance hacker moves $63 million in stolen ether after 2 weeks of silence
Crypto.reason: Active criminal proceeds movement increases on-chain uncertainty and potential sell pressure; material for market trust and short-term liquidity dynamics.

Crypto.title: Hackers plant crypto-stealing code on 178 major websites, including HSBC and Ledger
Crypto.reason: Systemic security incident affecting custodial and consumer endpoints raises counterparty and custody risk across the ecosystem — significant negative for sentiment and on-chain activity.

Crypto.title: After $6.3 billion crypto heist, Binance plans foray into 5 Asian markets
Crypto.reason: Mixed signal: large heist headline is negative for trust and risk appetite, while exchange expansion is a competitive/market-structure development. Net negative due to reputational and security overhang.

Crypto.title: U.S. judge says Ethereum has ‘no terms of use,’ clears MIT brothers of $25 million fraud
Crypto.reason: Legal/regulatory development that reduces immediate fraud liability for protocol-level claims—lowers legal tail risk for Ethereum and is a positive for ETH sentiment and regulatory clarity.

Crypto.title: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade risks breaking up to 15,000 automated apps
Crypto.reason: Protocol upgrade risk: potential breakage of automated apps could cause service disruption and reduce confidence/utility in the short term—material technical downside for ETH ecosystem.

Crypto.title: XRP whales moved $270 million during the selloff. The coins didn’t go to exchanges
Crypto.reason: On-chain accumulation signal: large transfers off-exchange indicate potential hoarding/long-term holding by whales, a short-term positive supply-side dynamic for XRP.

Crypto.title: Coinbase CEO says AI agents will account for '99.9%' of transactions within a decade
Crypto.reason: Long-term adoption narrative combining AI and crypto infrastructure; positive for on-chain transaction growth and product innovation though impact is gradual.

Crypto.title: Solana Foundation takes majority stake in crypto data provider CoinGecko
Crypto.reason: Ecosystem/infrastructure investment that strengthens Solana's data and market-info footprint—positive but relatively niche and medium-term.

Crypto.title: Ex-OpenAI researcher fund dumps bitcoin miners, cuts IREN 94% after portfolio slump
Crypto.reason: Asset-manager liquidations and deep cuts to miner exposure reduce speculative bid into mining equities and may signal risk-off among sophisticated crypto investors—modestly negative for miner tokens and equities.

Crypto.title: CFTC nominee questions public benefit of prediction markets as legal fight grows
Crypto.reason: Regulatory headwind for prediction-market products and tokens: signals potential stricter scrutiny from U.S. regulators, modestly negative for that sub-sector and regulatory sentiment more broadly.
